g_eee1470ccc33.title: Make JSONStorage writes crash-safe so a mid-write crash cannot leave a truncated db.json

anchorAsk.text: One of our services got OOM-killed in the middle of a write last week and its db.json came back truncated, so TinyDB couldn't open it anymore. Can you make JSONStorage writes crash-safe, so a process dying mid-write can't leave a half-written file behind?
